mentions.name: chernoffOT
mentions.description: This tool pulls OpenTelemetry data from your infrastructure and renders Chernoff faces, so anomalies can be spotted at a glance.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built chernoffOT for fun - https://github.com/ashinvinod/chernoffOT

It basically pulls OpenTelemetry data from your infra and renders chernoff faces, so you can spot anomalies at a glance.
